Hedgehog: pawns on b6, d6 and e6 and none on the c-file, against pawns on c4 and e4 and none on the d-file (colours may be reversed). hints: Find the pawns on the c-, d- and e-files for both colours first.

Carlsbad: a pawn on d4 and one on e3 with no pawn on the c-file for that side, against pawns on c6, d5 and e6 (colours may be reversed). Isolated queen's pawn: a pawn on d4 with no pawn of its colour on the c- or e-file (for Black: on d5; colours may be reversed). Maroczy bind: pawns on c4 and e4 and none on the d-file, against pawns on d6 and g6 and none on the c-file (colours may be reversed). Hedgehog: pawns on b6, d6 and e6 and none on the c-file, against pawns on c4 and e4 and none on the d-file (colours may be reversed). Advance French chain: pawns on d4 and e5 against pawns on d5 and e6 (colours may be reversed).
Check the file conditions (no pawn on a file) as carefully as the squares.
